# pvecli vm

Manage virtual machines (QEMU).

| Command | What it does |
|:--|:--|
| [`start`](start.md) | Start one or more VMs. |
| [`stop`](stop.md) | Stop one or more VMs (hard stop). |
| [`shutdown`](shutdown.md) | Shutdown one or more VMs gracefully. |
| [`reboot`](reboot.md) | Reboot one or more VMs. |
| [`suspend`](suspend.md) | Suspend one or more VMs. |
| [`resume`](resume.md) | Resume one or more suspended VMs. |
| [`lock`](lock.md) | Lock a VM - requires root@pam authentication. |
| [`unlock`](unlock.md) | Unlock a VM - requires root@pam authentication. |
| [`add`](add.md) | Create a new VM interactively or with options. |
| [`deploy`](deploy.md) | Create a ready-to-use VM from a cloud-init template in one command. |
| [`clone`](clone.md) | Clone a VM. |
| [`migrate`](migrate.md) | Migrate a VM to another node of the cluster. |
| [`edit`](edit.md) | Interactively edit VM configuration. |
| [`remove`](remove.md) | Delete one or more VMs. |
| [`tag`](tag.md) | Manage VM tags. |
| [`snapshot`](snapshot.md) | Manage VM snapshots. |
| [`template`](template.md) | Convert one or more VMs to templates. |
| [`ha`](ha.md) | Manage VM HA resources. |
| [`cloudinit`](cloudinit.md) | Cloud-init settings of a VM. |
| [`vnc`](vnc.md) | Open authenticated VNC console(s) for one or more VMs. |
| [`ssh`](ssh.md) | SSH into a VM (IP resolved via QEMU Guest Agent). |
| [`rdp`](rdp.md) | RDP into a VM (IP resolved via QEMU Guest Agent). |
| [`exec`](exec.md) | Execute a command in one or more VMs via QEMU Guest Agent. |
| [`list`](list.md) | List all VMs. |
| [`info`](info.md) | Show detailed information about a VM. |
| [`firewall`](firewall.md) | Manage the firewall of a VM. |
